data.name: Don Quijote
data.detailed_description:
In a small village in La Mancha, an aging nobleman named Alonso Quijano has read so many chivalric romances that he loses his grip on reality. Believing himself to be a knight-errant, he rechristens himself Don Quixote de la Mancha and sets out on a quest to revive the age of chivalry, right wrongs, and win glory in the name of his imagined lady love, Dulcinea del Toboso.

Accompanied by the pragmatic peasant Sancho Panza as his squire, Don Quixote journeys through a Spain that has no place for knights. He mistakes windmills for giants, inns for castles, and flocks of sheep for armies. Yet within his madness lies a profound nobility—a refusal to accept a world without honor, justice, and beauty.

Don Quijote is an interactive graphic novel that reimagines Cervantes' masterpiece through a unique neo-noir visual style. Every scene is drenched in dramatic shadows and cinematic lighting, transforming La Mancha into a landscape as beautiful as it is unforgiving.

KEY FEATURES


  • Branching narrative with over 200,000 words of dialogue, where your choices shape the story and determine four distinct endings.
  • Unique neo-noir visual style that fuses 17th-century Spain with film noir cinematography and composition.
  • Memorable characters from Cervantes' work, each with psychological depth and their own narrative arcs.
  • Meaningful choice system that poses the central question: can idealism survive in a world that has no use for it?
  • Collectible gallery with special illustrated scenes unlocked throughout your journey.
  • Universal accessibility: no reflex-based mechanics or time pressure. Enjoy the story at your own pace.
  • Dyslexia-friendly font, high contrast mode, adjustable text speed, and multiple font sizes.

data.short_description: An interactive graphic novel reimagining Cervantes' masterpiece in striking neo-noir style. Guide Don Quixote through La Mancha, make choices that shape his journey, and discover four unique endings in this tragicomic tale of idealism and madness.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU / Vulkan 1.0 compatible
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.2 compatible GPU with 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 3072 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 display recommended

content_descriptors.notes: The game explores themes of madness, disillusionment, mortality, and the loss of idealism. The protagonist's mental deterioration and madness are central to the narrative. These are treated with literary depth and compassionate humor, consistent with the source material.
